written_by_hand: The archive-level record of the Freddie Mac grid's foundation-model side on the upb_nominal matrix, on a rented RTX 4090: the node's whole console log, the job list the runner walked and its tally, and gpu.txt, copied unchanged from the result archive, and the facts that belong to the archive rather than to one job. The 34 job directories listed under jobs hold the rows and a manifest each.
host: Rented instance, 1x NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (24564 MiB), driver 615.71.09 (gpu.txt), Linux-7.0.0-31-generic-x86_64-with-glibc2.43, Python 3.12.14, torch 2.14.0 built against CUDA 13.0; vCPU count, RAM and the driver's CUDA version are not recorded in the result archive. This environment differs from the primary grid's (experiments/2026-09-14-fm-grid-rental-4090: Python 3.12.3, Linux-6.17.0-20-generic-x86_64-with-glibc2.39, driver 595.58.03) in the interpreter patch release, the kernel and glibc, and the driver; torch, tabpfn, tabicl, numpy, pandas, scikit-learn, the CUDA build and both checkpoints are the same. It equals the environment of the 2004H2-E draws run on this matrix (experiments/2026-09-14-fm-2004h2e-upb-nominal-tabpfn-draws-rental-4090).
gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090, 24564 MiB (25.34 GB reported by torch), torch 2.14.0 on cuda

checkpoint.name: tabpfn-v3-classifier-v3_default.ckpt
checkpoint.provenance: Travelled inside the job archive; hash checked directly against the pinned value, matches.

result_archive.name: outoftime-result-grid-fm-upb.tar.gz
result_archive.contents: 34 output directories (17 upb_nominal bundles x tabicl and tabpfn), each node.json, scores.parquet, reference.parquet, parts/; score.log, jobs.json, jobs-done.json, gpu.txt; no scorer, no bundle files; kept under data/derived/node/ with a .sha256 sidecar.
result_archive.row_level_data_note: scores.parquet, reference.parquet and parts/ under every -fm- experiment directory are covered by experiments/*-fm-*/**/*.parquet and experiments/*-fm-*/**/parts/ in .gitignore (the Freddie Mac dataset's terms forbid distributing the data or any derived product); only manifest.json, node.json, score.log and this index's jobs.json/jobs-done.json/gpu.txt are trackable. Verified with git check-ignore and git add --dry-run.

process.purpose: EXP-005's upb_nominal ablation trigger (docs/experiments/EXP-005-tfm-out-of-time-second-book.md, the paragraph on the nominal amount as the second ablation) fired: on the falsifying cells the difference-of-gains interval against GBM-50k excluded zero on the Brier score for tabicl and tabpfn at 0.9 (experiments/2026-09-14-fm-2004h2e-ablation-upb-nominal/summary.json, whose trigger list also names tabicl@t1 and tabpfn@t1, rows the note of 2026-09-14 leaves outside the trigger; ablation_intervals.py counts the eight rows of the note from 9b84a0b), and over the three context draws for tabicl and tabpfn (experiments/2026-09-14-fm-2004h2e-ablation-upb-nominal-draws/summary.json). The pre-registered consequence is that the foundation-model grid is scored on the nominal matrix as well and every verdict is reported on both, the ratio matrix's reading remaining the criterion's. The grid: tabicl and tabpfn on all 17 upb_nominal bundles (nine E builds 2002H2-E to 2018H2-E and eight R builds 2004H2-R to 2018H2-R), every cohort of every build, all three context seeds (20260911 to 20260913), 50,000 context rows, softmax_temperature 0.9 (the library default), --chunk 20000; each job's command is '--models <model> --chunk 20000' (jobs.json).
process.one_process: One process, 34 jobs, one continuous run.sh call: first job started 2026-09-14T21:31:49+00:00, last job finished 2026-09-15T11:16:31+00:00 (jobs-done.json, start = finish minus the tally's seconds); tally_seconds sums to 49,481.2s over the 34 jobs, equal to the span to within the runner's rounding; run.sh started every job within 0.8s of the previous one's finish.
process.console_log: score.log is the file node_jobs.py appends the scorer's console to on the node (run.sh passes it as --log), 3,072 lines for the whole run, one block per job in job-list order after a blank first line; the 34 per-job slices copied into the 34 job directories are lines-exact cuts of this file. Read in full: no home path beyond /home/node/outoftime-node, no account name; one occurrence of the word 'token' anywhere in the file, the Hugging Face Hub's own unauthenticated-request warning on the first tabicl job (line 3), where lines 6-7 record the TabICL checkpoint being fetched from the Hub; it is not fetched again on later tabicl jobs of the same run.

repeats.reading: The first cohort of each job is scored twice from a fresh fit as the repeat check (one repeat per context seed, so 3 x 34 = 102 total). 99 reproduce with zero difference. The 3 that do not are all tabicl on 2018H2-R, first cohort 2019H1, one per context seed; magnitudes and row counts are listed above. The primary matrix's grid shows the same: tabicl on 2018H2-R, cohort 2019H1, all three seeds (experiments/2026-09-14-fm-grid-rental-4090); no job of this grid was rerun.

TabICL at 1.0 is derived from its rows at 0.9 likewise, by the exact scale. The dti_kept matrix is not in this grid.
